top_signals.title: Muni Bond Yields Climb to Highest Since April 2025 Tariff Rout
top_signals.summary: Municipal bond yields jumped to the highest since April 2025, as rising Treasury rates and heavy new issue supply pressure the market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: UK House of Lords backs mandatory digital asset strategy over Labour position
top_signals.summary: The amendment would require the UK Treasury to develop a strategy covering cryptoassets, stablecoins, tokenized securities and digital financial infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Russian Mobilization Rumors Ripple Across Central Asia
top_signals.summary: Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan are introducing new procedures for foreign visitors. Some local observers believe the moves are connected to a fresh influx of Russians amid rumors that the Kremlin may order a general military mobilization. A Kyrgyz government decree outlines plans to implement a tracking system to ensure foreigners adhere to migration rules. Those who violate length-of-stay requirements will be barred from returning for a set period, as determined by the number of days a citizen of a given country can stay in Kyrgyzstan…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: AI is losing its stranglehold on the U.S. stock market. Here's why
top_signals.summary: A key tech-stock volatility metric options traders have been watching all year is reversing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: NSE Downsizes India IPO, Signaling Mounting Valuation Concern
top_signals.summary: National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. has downsized its initial public offering, a sign of mounting concern over the willingness of investors to buy into the deal at the valuation the firm had been seeking.

top_signals.summary: The wallet now supports more than 10 networks, including Robinhood Chain and Monad, plus perps, prediction markets, and tokenized stocks.
